title: Dual Government & 1770 Famine: deputies, effects, revolt

boxes.title: Deputies: added detail
head: Deputy
Added point
rows: Appointed by **Clive** after Allahabad; also ==**Naib Nazim**== for the minor Nawab [GK]

boxes.title: Effects: added detail
items: Bengal ruined in ==under two decades==: famines, **epidemics**
First formal Company control of revenue → scholars trace **drain of wealth** + ==**deindustrialisation**==
**Mir Qasim** had abolished internal duties for all, in protest at dastak misuse
R.P. Dutt: Mercantilist phase = first of his **three** stages

boxes.title: Famine: added detail
items: Area: **lower Gangetic plain**; one of the deadliest famines
Revenue squeezed even as famine spread → hurt Company's ==reputation==, more local opposition
Hastings ended the system **on becoming Governor** of Bengal
